additions.description: POST /logs validates that each required field value is an instance of str in addition to checking presence
additions.reasoning: The specification only states that the POST request provides cardholderId, borrowId, ISBN, and loanDate as required fields. It does not require type validation on those values. The code adds an explicit isinstance(data[field], str) check that has no basis in the specification.

omissions.description: GET /logs silently ignores query parameters that are not in the hardcoded whitelist, rather than applying them as filters
omissions.reasoning: The specification states 'A GET request may specify a query string of the form field=value. In this case, only those log records satisfying that constraint should be returned.' The code only filters on a fixed set of known field names and ignores any other field=value pair, which does not fully implement the general field=value filtering requirement.
